tests.name: scheduled-notifications health stays open and reports log mode

tests.reason: proves the token check in all three modes (enforce rejects 401/403/503, log passes and never logs the header, off skips), /health open, every gateway self-call sending the token, the prod/staging workflow wiring and the four scheduler scripts. No POST is ever sent on staging: in log mode an anonymous POST would run a real dispatch against the shared production database
